regional.exchange: Exchange Three: select three tiles from the same suit ({n}/3).
regional.chooseVoid: Choose your forbidden suit (fewest tiles only).
regional.scope: This table uses Mahjong Hub's regional rules baseline.
regional.replayCopyFallback: Copy the replay URL from your address bar.
regional.readyHint: Choose a highlighted discard to declare ready.
regional.scoreTaiwanHand: This 0-Tai baseline uses 16 tiles: five melds and a pair. Settlement is base plus Tai.
regional.scoreTaiwanFlowers: Flowers and seat flowers draw replacements and add Tai; Eight Flowers and Seven Rob One settle immediately in this table baseline.
regional.scoreTaiwanSettlement: Self draw is paid by all three opponents. Discard wins, rob-kong, and kong-draw wins use this table's base-plus-Tai settlement.
regional.scoreSichuanHand: Chengdu Blood Battle starts with Exchange Three and a missing suit; winners leave play until three players win or the wall runs out.
regional.scoreSichuanKong: An exposed kong is paid by the discarder; a concealed kong is shared by the other three players. Kongs draw a replacement tile.
regional.scoreSichuanDraw: At a draw, the table applies ready-hand, flower-pig, and kong-score fallback settlement under this product's capped-fan baseline.
